_help: Site-wide news. Newest first is not required (the site sorts by date). tag is one of: site, anyps, anderscraft, games, vault. url is optional and may be a path on this site. Leave date as "" for an undated note.

items.title: A floating page menu
items.body: The top-left menu is now a constellation of page cards you can drift through, each with a short description. Prefer it calmer? Flip it to a neat grid with the toggle inside.

items.title: Search the whole site
items.body: Press the “/” key or the new search button in the header to jump straight to any page, or on to the game ratings.

items.title: The Trophy Cabinet
items.body: Every trophy in one place at /trophies/, with tiers, earned dates and filters. A few new ones, and some secret codes, are hiding in there too.

items.title: An arcade of little games
items.body: The browser games from the 404 page now have a home of their own.

items.title: “Right now” on the hub
items.body: A live strip up top shows when I'm streaming, whether the AndersCraft realms are online, and the week's top-rated game.

items.title: A guided first look
items.body: First time here? A quick, easy-to-skip tour points out the landmarks on the hub.

items.title: Friends of DaManAnders on Discord
items.body: A new page for the community server, with go-live pings, a review feed, project channels and a one-click join.

items.title: Screenshots on the AnyPS page
items.body: A new gallery of the launcher in action, with a full-screen viewer.

items.title: The AndersCraft page, reforged
items.body: A new look for the realm page, with a forge-lit hero and a live pulse on the hardcore realm.

items.title: Every platform, one place
items.body: Rate-O-Pedia now covers hundreds of thousands of games across dozens of platforms, with per-platform hubs, leaderboards and a weekly roundup of what's hot.

items.title: Make your profile your own
items.body: Members get a customisable profile now — banners, colours, badges, a backlog and a guestbook — plus reactions on reviews and backlog buttons on every game.

items.title: Classic skin, new season sounds and 13 more trophies
items.body: Pick Classic in settings for the original lighthouse look with the ocean. Fall, winter, spring and summer each have their own soundscape now.

items.title: Links I Like, and a menu on every page
items.body: A page of sites I use, with a public ranking you can vote on, plus a menu button at the top left of every page.

items.title: Seasons, trophies and secrets
items.body: The site now dresses for the season, hands out trophies for exploring, and reacts to a few words if you just type them.

items.title: New pages: What's new, Uses and Stream
items.body: A full changelog, a page about the tools behind the projects, and a stream page that shows the player only while a broadcast is live.

items.title: An interactive résumé
items.body: Work history, projects and skills in one place, reached from the bottom of the hub.

items.title: Rate-O-Pedia Forums opened
items.body: Search thousands of PlayStation games and rate them from 0 to 5. Discord members can vote and review.

items.title: The hub got a big refresh
items.body: Live status chips, a theme switch, controller navigation, a news ticker and a lot of polish across every page.

items.title: AnyPS V1.05.1 is out
items.body: A snappier in-game overlay, PS3 memory tools fixed, and a saved-values list with stay-on mods.

items.title: AnyPS now has a 32-bit Windows edition
items.body: A small PSP-only build for older 32-bit PCs.

items.title: AnyPS V1.05: one-press updates
items.body: AnyPS can now update itself in place and keeps your games, saves and sign-ins. Also a redesigned start-up screen.

items.title: AnyPS V1.04: PS Vita joins the shelf
items.body: PlayStation Vita support, memory tools, save states and checkpoints, a save vault and smart lists.

items.title: AnyPS V1.03
items.body: Mass install, a set-up wizard, a cheats manager, PS3 online accounts inside AnyPS and the first self-updater.

items.title: AnyPS V1.02
items.body: User profiles, collections, tutorials, a visual controller remap and game backgrounds, music and video.

items.title: AnyPS V1.0 released
items.body: The first public build of the launcher.

items.title: Choose your avenue
items.body: The site became a hub for AndersCraft and AnyPS.

items.title: AndersCraft sign-ups are open
items.body: Create a game account right from the website.

items.title: Level cap raised to 125
items.body: The journey keeps going after 80, with combat tuned for the new levels.

items.title: Quality-of-life pack
items.body: Transmog, account-wide mounts, dungeons that scale to your group, cross-faction battlegrounds, a bigger bank, Mythic+ and a stocked auction house.
